## Bio

I'm Karthik Tatineni, an Independent Software Developer and Electronics & Communication Engineering student at the Institute of Aeronautical Engineering (IARE), Hyderabad.

I specialize in building scalable web applications, distributed systems, and AI-driven platforms, blending robust software architecture with a foundation in electronics. My software expertise spans full-stack development, cloud deployment, and computer vision. I have architected high-availability platforms handling thousands of concurrent users, developed multi-agent AI systems, and implemented real-time YOLO-based detection pipelines.

While my core focus is software engineering, my background in electronics gives me a unique edge in hardware-software integration. I enjoy tinkering with IoT, embedded systems, and sensor networks. I aim to architect scalable software solutions and build impactful technologies that bridge the gap between intelligent code and the physical world.

## Projects

### AI/ML

#### FraudGuard — Real-Time Free-Trial Abuse & Multi-Accounting Risk Engine
Enterprise real-time anti-fraud engine preventing SaaS free-trial farming and multi-accounting syndicates using Causal Entity Graphs, Active Learning, and calibrated risk scoring. Features a strictly causal feature engineering pipeline with an Incremental Union-Find Entity Graph. Trained across 7 ML algorithms with tuned XGBoost delivering 95.1% Abuse Recall, 76.2% Precision, and 0.976 ROC-AUC. Includes continuous PSI drift monitoring, Human-in-the-Loop Active Learning, sub-15ms FastAPI async REST microservice, and Redis sliding-window velocity caching.
- Tech: Python, FastAPI, XGBoost, Scikit-Learn, Redis, Docker, Active Learning, SHAP, Pandas, NumPy, GitHub Actions CI/CD
- GitHub: https://github.com/karthiktatineni/Free-trail-Fraud-detection-MLmodel
- Live: https://free-trail-fraud-detection-mlmodel.onrender.com/

#### DeepSeek Coder Fine-Tuning — Cloud-Based LLM Training Pipeline
Fine-tuned DeepSeek Coder 6.7B using QLoRA on cloud GPUs to build a domain-specific coding assistant. Built an end-to-end cloud-based QLoRA fine-tuning pipeline using T4 GPU instances on Lightning.ai. Evaluated the fine-tuned model through inference comparison, checkpoint management, and benchmarking against the base model.
- Tech: Python, PyTorch, DeepSeek Coder 6.7B, QLoRA, LoRA, BitsAndBytes, Transformers, TRL, PEFT, Hugging Face, NVIDIA GPU
- GitHub: https://github.com/karthiktatineni/Finetuning-deepseek-coder-6.7b

#### DisasterMind AI — Autonomous Disaster Intelligence
Autonomous Emergency Operations Center using multi-agent AI to predict and manage disaster response. Uses a Multi-Agent Orchestration architecture where specialized AI agents collaborate, debate, and refine plans. Features predictive ML to forecast casualties, infrastructure damage, and hospital overload before they happen.
- Tech: Next.js, FastAPI, NVIDIA NIM, Azure AI Foundry, PostgreSQL, Redis, Machine Learning, Multi-Agent AI
- GitHub: https://github.com/karthiktatineni/DisasterMind-AI-agents
- Live: https://disaster-mind-ai-agents.vercel.app/

#### Aegis AI — Local-First AI Assistant Platform
Full-stack AI platform with local LLMs, RAG, long-term memory, agent planning, streaming chat, and ChromaDB-powered retrieval. Features real-time streaming chat, persistent conversation history, semantic search, and an extensible agent architecture with planning capabilities and tool execution.
- Tech: Next.js, FastAPI, Python, TypeScript, PyTorch, Transformers, Mistral 7B, Qwen 2.5, ChromaDB, Sentence Transformers, SQLAlchemy, Docker
- GitHub: https://github.com/karthiktatineni/Aegis-AI
- Live: https://llm-web-rho.vercel.app/

#### Autonomous AI Agentic Team
Multi-agent developer pipeline using MCP and Claude Code for end-to-end software builds. Leverages the Model Context Protocol for communication between 10+ AI agents including Researchers, Architects, Coders, and Security Auditors.
- Tech: Claude Code, MCP Protocol, Node.js, React, Ollama, Docker, WebSockets
- GitHub: https://github.com/karthiktatineni/claude-code-agentic-team

#### Helmet & Triple-Ride Detection
YOLO and CNN-based system to detect helmet use and triple riding using real-time camera feed. Uses deep learning (YOLOv5 + CNN) optimized for accuracy and real-time performance.
- Tech: YOLOv5, CNN, OpenCV, PyTorch, Python
- GitHub: https://github.com/karthiktatineni/Helmet-tripleride-Detection

#### AI-Powered Fitness Tracker (Flutter App)
Premium AI workout planner and fitness tracker built with Flutter and Google Gemini AI. Integrates Google Gemini AI to dynamically generate exercise routines. Features secure Firebase authentication and comprehensive progress tracking.
- Tech: Flutter, Firebase, Google Gemini AI, Dart, Provider
- GitHub: https://github.com/karthiktatineni/GYMapp-flutter

#### AI-Powered ESP32
ESP32-AI system integrated with Gemini AI to respond to questions asked. Combines AI conversation with real-time audio output for voice-based interaction on embedded hardware.
- Tech: ESP32, Google Gemini AI, Text-to-Speech, Arduino IDE, Wi-Fi
- GitHub: https://github.com/karthiktatineni/Gemini-integrated-ESP32

#### OLLAMA Based Local AI
Local AI on ESP32 using OLLAMA on PC. Allows ESP32 to communicate with advanced language models like LLaMA, Phi, Mistral, and Gemma without cloud services.
- Tech: ESP32, Ollama, LLaMA/Phi/Mistral, Ngrok, HTTP API
- GitHub: https://github.com/karthiktatineni/Ollama_on_ESP32
